how_to_read: A FLOOR, not a fair value: it values the contracted book and nothing else, so a reading below the price is the expected case. What carries information is how the gap MOVES across origins — here it closes steadily from -72% to -4% over 2016-2019, which is a statement about the order book growing faster than the share price, not a valuation claim. Four origins on one name is not a finding.
